raw_text: Agnipath scheme is death of military careers for youth! All aspirants must join protest at railway stations tomorrow. Block all trains in Bihar and UP. Patna Junction, Danapur, Ara, Buxar — all stations must be occupied. This corrupt scheme must be withdrawn. Share in all youth groups now!
clean_text: Anti-Agnipath protest calls targeting railway stations in Bihar and UP. Specific stations listed including Patna Junction, Danapur, Ara, and Buxar for occupation and rail blockades.
